notes.summary: The fourth word of verse (2:3) is divided into 3 morphological segments. A conjunction, verb and subject pronoun. The prefixed conjunction wa is usually translated as "and". The form IV imperfect verb (فعل مضارع) is third person masculine plural and is in the indicative mood (مرفوع). The verb's triliteral root is qāf wāw mīm (ق و م). The suffix (الواو) is an attached subject pronoun.
The third word of verse (1:6) is a form X masculine active participle and is in the accusative case (منصوب). The active participle's triliteral root is qāf wāw mīm (ق و م).
